verdict.rationale: Cline Kanban is documented as a web-based task board for running many coding agents in parallel, with isolated per-card git worktrees, auto-commit, dependency chains, and diff review with inline comments in the card detail view. The native desktop app separately says it can run agent sessions in any folder and manage routines, models, plugins, and MCP servers. Together these give a lead one unified place to orchestrate multiple agent sessions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Kanban or the desktop app, and deeper documentation of cross-session status monitoring and lifecycle control.
